name: Instant-read thermometer
definition: hand-held probe thermometer that gives a food temperature reading within seconds when inserted
notes: ThermoWorks sells Instant-Reads as its own section (Thermapen ONE, ThermoPop 2, DASH)

name: Probe alarm thermometer
definition: thermometer with a probe left in the food or oven and an alarm that sounds at a set temperature
notes: ThermoWorks Alarm Thermometers section (ChefAlarm, Signals, DOT)

name: Infrared thermometer
definition: thermometer that reads surface temperature from a distance by infrared, aimed at the food or pan
notes: ThermoWorks Infrareds section; Thermapen IR combines infrared and probe

name: Champagne glass [flute or coupe]
definition: stemmed glass made for sparkling wine, tall flute or wide coupe
notes: Iwa Wine lists Champagne Glasses beside Red Wine and White Wine glasses; Viski Sparkling Wine Glasses
